senses.gloss:
r. 1st cl. (पेठति)
1 To hurt or kill.
2 To feel pain or affliction.

m. (-ठः)
Pain, distress.
E.
पिठ, and क aff.

mfn. (-ठः-ठी-ठं)
1 A stool, a seat, a chair.
2 The seat of the religious student, made properly of Kuśa grass.
3 A place where some limb of PĀRVATĪ is supposed to have fallen, as after Daksha's sacrifice, her dead body was carried about by ŚIVA, and cut in pieces by the discus of VIṢṆU: there are fifty-one such places.
4 Complement of a segment, (in Geometry.)
E.
पिठ to feel pain, to be weary, aff. घञ्; deriv. irr.

mf. (-रः-री)
A pot, a pan.
n. (-रं)
1 A churning stick.
2 A fragrant grass, (Cyperus rotundus.)
3 A sort of building, a hut or watch box made of bambus and mats, or as it is [] sometimes explained, a kind of store room or scullery.
E.
पिठ pain, रा to take, aff. क.

m. (-लिः)
A male confidant, a parasite.
E.
पीठ a seat, and केलि sport.

m. (-र्द्दः)
A parasite, a companion.
E.
पीठ a seat, and मृद to rub, aff. घञ्.

m. (-र्पी)
A cripple, who moves about on a wheeled chair, &c.
E.
पीठ a seat, and सर्पिन् who moves.

n. (-नं)
A place where some limb of PĀRVATĪ is supposed to have fallen: see पीठ.
E.
पीठ, and स्थान place.
